QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] Obsession and Insanity
QuestInfo.0: #bMedina#k asked you to stay put for a bit. Now talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Report to #bGardin#k of the Cygnus Knights.
QuestInfo.2: Medina says this Elixir of Everlasting Youth is actually a magical potion containing pure #bobsession and insanity#k. She's not sure why Hilla made such a potion, but it's clear things didn't pan out the way she intended.

0.0: I've figured out the #bcomponents of this potion#k.
0.1: This potion has nothing to do with immortality. It's pretty much pure evil.\r\nIt extracts #bobsession and insanity#k that might be hiding away in the deep, hidden parts of a person's heart. I don't know why #bHilla#k made this, but it sure isn't for anything good.
0.2: Since you were able to retrieve this, it means #bHilla#k didn't get her way. \r\nIt's all thanks to you, #h0#.
0.3: We must uncover what Hilla was scheming. Meanwhile, can you go let the #bknights#k know what we've learned about the potion so far?

yes.0: Please go speak to #bGardin#k of the Cygnus Knights.

1.0: I see.\r\nI don't know what #bHilla#k intended, but I'm glad you stopped it. We will place more guards at the passages to prevent any more of these plots.

default.0: Gardin is at the Azwan Obelisk.
